source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Morocco 2026 Puma Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker. Named-press kit write-up: the shirt carries the Puma logo and the Royal Moroccan Football Federation crest only, with matching red shorts and socks; no commercial sponsor on any placement. FootyLogos (2026) likewise describes gold PUMA branding and the crest as the shirt's only marks.
source.quote: The Puma logo appears in gold on the chest, alongside the Royal Moroccan Football Federation crest in a central position.

summary: Puma home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle. No commercial shirt sponsors: kit-press write-ups describe only the FRMF crest and Puma branding on the shirt, with matching sponsor-free shorts.
